eventClusters.statement: Shanghai reopening, supply-chain normalization and a nationwide purchase-tax cut combined with sharply improving May auto production and still-rapid NEV demand, creating a policy-plus-operating recovery in autos.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Policy and production recovery are real, but Jan-May auto-industry profits were still deeply negative. Company-level margin/cash conversion is mandatory.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share automaker or component supplier had a realized earnings bridge from reopening/stimulus with acceptable expectation burden?

eventClusters.statement: Coal and oil/gas extraction profits more than doubled year on year through April-May while downstream power, refining and manufacturing profits deteriorated, creating a clear commodity value-chain profit transfer.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The earnings windfall may already be priced after the commodity rally. Deep research must compare duration/valuation and avoid treating high spot profits as permanent.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which listed resource producer had durable low-cost earnings and valuation room rather than peak-cycle profit extrapolation?

eventClusters.statement: PV demand remained strong while polysilicon supply was constrained, suppliers were fully booked and prices kept rising into late June, creating a direct upstream scarcity profit pool but cost pressure downstream.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: High upstream prices can generate extraordinary producer profits but may be peak-cycle; downstream margins differ. Selection needs realized earnings plus expectation-duration discipline.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is the best A-share expression an upstream scarcity producer or a downstream beneficiary, and is the profit duration under-reflected?

eventClusters.statement: Manufacturing PMI collapsed to 47.4 in April, recovered to 49.6 in May and returned to 50.2 in June as lockdowns eased, showing real recovery but from a severe disruption.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Useful timing context but too broad to create a stock thesis.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as regime context and contradiction evidence only.
